base_assumption: Patch-01, Patch-06, Patch-05, Patch-02, and Patch-03 have already been applied

clock_resources.name: macro
clock_resources.error_unwind: err_dcodec/reg_component_fail chain disables macro after dcodec/mclk unwinds

clock_resources.name: dcodec
clock_resources.error_unwind: err_mclk/reg_component_fail chain disables dcodec if mclk/component registration fails

clock_resources.name: mclk
clock_resources.enable_path: probe, runtime_resume, VA mclk helper paths
clock_resources.disable_path: runtime_suspend, probe error unwind, remove path, VA mclk helper paths
clock_resources.error_unwind: reg_component_fail disables mclk after component registration failure; tx/mclk helper disables mclk when fsgen request fails

clock_resources.name: fsgen
clock_resources.disable_path: DAPM mclk/tx event unwind and POST_PMD paths
clock_resources.error_unwind: mclk event disables fsgen if downstream VA mclk enable fails

local_helpers.name: va_clk_rsc_fs_gen_request

local_helpers.name: lpass_va_macro_tx_mclk_enable
local_helpers.purpose: replace Patch-02 placeholder for lpass_cdc_tx_mclk_enable with local upstream-clock helper
local_helpers.enable_path: lpass_cdc_va_macro_mclk_event when LPI mixer path bypasses VA mclk path

assumptions.assumption: fsgen is acquired by the upstream clock name and treated as optional in this generated conversion artifact
assumptions.reason: upstream VA macro obtains fsgen from the registered fsgen clock provider after probe setup; this artifact does not introduce that provider plumbing
